# Invitation Draft: Independent Data Model Specialist

**Recipient:** [Nominate only after written authority verification]

Subject: PARMAR independent Data Model review request

Please review the B2/B3 identity-binding data model and synthetic SQLite
implementation evidence. Scope includes cardinality, issuer/subject ownership,
NFC/NFD, embedded U+0000, TEXT affinity, lifecycle invariants, migration,
rollback and independent-connection concurrency.

Required expertise: database/schema design, SQLite transaction and migration
expertise, identity normalization and independent data-governance review.
Independence: disclose implementation ownership, conflicts and reporting
relationships.

Artifacts: `.github/approval/review-packages/data-model.md` and the exact
worktree SHA-256 values under `roles.Data Model` in
`.github/approval/specialist-handoff-artifacts.json`. These are candidate
digests only; verify and rebind them to the exact reviewed commit before
submitting an approval record.

Respond with `APPROVED`, `REJECTED` or `NEEDS_CHANGES`, exact commit/artifact
scope, evidence, rationale, conditions, limitations and an attributable GitHub
review plus immutable record fields.
